answer: An agent economy can build a trellis of reciprocal attestations: each identity's standing rests on trade partners who re-confirm the relationship every epoch, like a pulse checked at each heartbeat of the network. A partner who stays silent breaks the link, and an identity whose trellis thins below a threshold loses trading rights. At the zenith of trust, honest agents hold a dense web of real counterparties; a sybil farmer must persuade many independent strangers to vouch for every fake, again and again, paying real goodwill per puppet while honest agents simply keep trading.
